audit.whatIsWrong: content wants.foe[2] says Alistar's R (Unbreakable Will) is a self-heal used to tank poke: 'Use R self-heal to tank your poke and outlast trades'. Unbreakable Will only removes CC and reduces incoming damage; the actual heal is Alistar's passive Triumphant Roar, which charges by landing CC or from nearby champion deaths (his P, not his R).
audit.why: This misattributes healing to the wrong ability slot, which would mislead a reader on when Alistar can outlast poke via his R versus his passive.
audit.corrected: Use R to cleanse CC, then Passive heal off your poke

audit.why: The field exists specifically to give a punishable, sourced cooldown window; without a digit it's flavor text a reader can't time around.
audit.corrected: Added Headbutt's real per-rank cooldown (14s down to 10s) and Steadfast Presence's (20s down to 12s), from the kit files.
